ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: The History of Native People in Latin America Description: How can we write the history of the indigenous people of Latin America from the colonial period to the modern era? This question has vexed generations of historians and they have found different ways of writing about the native people from Meso- and South America, their cultures, and their adaptations to new cultural influences. By reading the most outstanding of these historians - with a particular focus on the Andes - we want to analyze how Western concepts of natives have changed over time. Whenever we can, we try to counter these narratives with native peoples' own historiographies and self-perceptions. By doing so, we are induced to reflect upon changing historical methods over almost six hundred years; not least to reflect upon our own historical methods.
